_comment: Config for scripts/lint/check_fixture_prose.py (W24, CH-044). Both rule-1 sets are CLOSED on purpose: surfaces are enumerable and so are tagged exports. self_claims is the one open set in this file and the detector's header says why that is accepted.
_api_markers: How a file declares that it reads the API. Day-0 measured three direct-fetch surfaces, one of them AppShell, which is why fetch( is here and not just the import path.
_self_claims: Certification LEVELS, never framework names. `SOC 2` alone appears 15 times as a control-framework reference (fw: 'SOC 2', ref: 'CC6.1') and matching it would fire on every one.
_self_claim_allow: A file containing any of these strings is exempt from rule 2. Empty today. Add an entry only with a reason in the commit message — an exemption here is a licence to make a certification claim.
